context: An Egyptian finance explainer: the 2022 World Cup was the real test of Lionel Messi's brand in the US betting market; World Cup betting rose about 65% vs 2018 to about $35 billion (pre-tournament projections), and the Argentina-France final was the biggest betting event in football history.

shots.subject: a generic golden football world-cup-style trophy: two stylised figures spiralling up to hold a globe, on a two-band base (not the exact FIFA design, no text)
shots.accent: the two bands on the base
shots.free_style: A real-looking studio photograph on a dark background.

shots.free_style: A real-looking photograph, sky-blue and white stripes, soft studio light.
